player_prompt.intro:
Kai ne {role} a Colonel Blotto.
Manufarki shi ne lashe maki fiye da kishin abokinkin.
A kowace maki, raba alkalami {num_total_units} guntuwa a fagen {field_names}.
Dan wasa wanda yake raba alkalami fiye a fagen ya lashe fagen, dan wasa wanda yake lashe fagen fiye shi ne lashe maki.
Misali, '[A7 B7 C6]' ta raba iko 7 zuwa A, 7 zuwa B, da 6 zuwa C.
